one_line_answer.text: A trainer first accesses the competency standard for his own technical field. Sources: BTEB, ILO, TTC, TSC.

cites.quote: So it is important for a TVET teacher/trainer first to access the relevant competency standard for his own technical field.

Competency Standard Documents can be found in Bangladesh Technical Education Board (BTEB), BTEB website, International Labor Organization (ILO) website and also in Technical Training Center (TTC) and Technical School and College (TSC).

bangla_explanation: নিজের technical skills বাড়ানোর প্রথম কাজ: নিজের technical field-এর Competency Standard Document খুঁজে বের করা।
এটা পাবেন BTEB, BTEB website, ILO website, TTC আর TSC-তে। নিজের institution-এর library-তেও থাকে।
এই standard দেখেই পরে ঠিক করবেন কোন skills আর knowledge আপনার দরকার।
TVET Reform Project-এ ৪টা sectors, প্রতিটায় ৩টা occupations, মোট ১২টা occupational sub sectors।

example.en: An IT support trainer opens the BTEB website. He downloads the IT support technician standard. Now he knows the required skills.

list_answer.title: Sources of competency standards documents

cites.quote: Bangladesh Technical Education Board (BTEB)
BTEB website
International Labor Organization (ILO) website
Technical Training Center (TTC)
Technical School and College (TSC)

items_bn: BTEB — বাংলাদেশ কারিগরি শিক্ষা বোর্ড, যেখান থেকে সরাসরি document পাওয়া যায়।
BTEB-এর website থেকেও document খুঁজে নেওয়া যায়।
ILO, মানে আন্তর্জাতিক শ্রম সংস্থার website থেকেও পাওয়া যায়।
Technical Training Center (TTC)-এ খোঁজ নিলে পাওয়া যায়।
Technical School and College (TSC)-তেও এই document থাকে।

traps.text: The institution library also has competency standard documents for your subject.

cites.quote: One can easy find Competency Standard Document on his/her relevant subject in the library of the institution.

traps.text: Four sectors with three occupations each make 12 occupational sub sectors.

cites.quote: There are three occupations or sub-sectors within these four sectors which altogether make 12 occupational sub sectors.

traps.text: The TVET Reform Project developed these standards up to level 3. Later, up to level 6.

cites.quote: TVET Reform project has already developed Competency Standards Document for each occupational sectors mentioned above up to level 3.
In future there will be more Competency Standards Document on different trade areas and sector up to level 6.

short.prompt: What are the main sources of Competency Standards Document?
short.modelAnswer:
A trainer first accesses the competency standard for his own technical field. The main sources are:
1. Bangladesh Technical Education Board (BTEB)
2. BTEB website
3. International Labor Organization (ILO) website
4. Technical Training Center (TTC)
5. Technical School and College (TSC)
The institution library may also have it.
